fn ov_resources_type_key(stage: *OvStage, syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax,
                         text: *OvText, depth: usize, user: *u8) -> bool {
    if (*syntax).kind != RS_READ && (*syntax).kind != RS_MUT { return false; }
    ov_encode_type(stage, (*syntax).base, text, depth + 1usize);
    return true;
}

fn ov_resources_binding_type(stage: *OvStage, syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax,
                             user: *u8) -> *RmdTypeSyntax {
    if (*syntax).kind == RS_READ || (*syntax).kind == RS_MUT { return (*syntax).base; }
    return syntax;
}

fn ov_resources_expression(walk: *OvWalk, expression: *RmdExpr,
                           expected: *RmdTypeSyntax, user: *u8) -> *RmdTypeSyntax {
    var stage: *OvStage = (*walk).stage;
    var kind: u32 = (*expression).kind;
    var location: *RmdLoc = &(*expression).loc;
    if kind == RS_MOVE { return ov_expression(walk, (*expression).left, expected); }
    if kind == RS_READ || kind == RS_MUT {
        var operand_expected: *RmdTypeSyntax = null(*RmdTypeSyntax);
        if expected != null(*RmdTypeSyntax) && (*expected).kind == kind {
            operand_expected = (*expected).base;
        }
        var base: *RmdTypeSyntax = ov_expression(walk, (*expression).left, operand_expected);
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
        var result: *RmdTypeSyntax = ov_type(stage, kind, location);
        if result != null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { (*result).base = base; }
        return result;
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_UNARY && (*expression).op == RMD_OP_DEREF {
        var operand: *RmdTypeSyntax = ov_expression(walk, (*expression).left, null(*RmdTypeSyntax));
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
        if (*operand).kind != RMD_T_POINTER && (*operand).kind != RS_READ && (*operand).kind != RS_MUT {
            ov_error(stage, location, "dereference requires a pointer or borrowed view");
            return null(*RmdTypeSyntax);
        }
        return (*operand).base;
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_FIELD || kind == RMD_E_INDEX {
        var base: *RmdTypeSyntax = ov_expression(walk, (*expression).left, null(*RmdTypeSyntax));
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
        if (*base).kind == RS_READ || (*base).kind == RS_MUT { base = (*base).base; }
        if kind == RMD_E_FIELD {
            if (*base).kind == RMD_T_POINTER { base = (*base).base; }
            return ov_field_type(stage, base, (*expression).field_name, location);
        }
        ov_expression(walk, (*expression).right, null(*RmdTypeSyntax));
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
        if (*base).kind != RMD_T_ARRAY && (*base).kind != RMD_T_POINTER {
            ov_error(stage, location, "indexing requires an array or raw pointer");
            return null(*RmdTypeSyntax);
        }
        return (*base).base;
    }
    return null(*RmdTypeSyntax);
}

fn ov_resources_statement(walk: *OvWalk, statement: *RmdStmt, user: *u8) -> bool {
    if (*statement).kind == RS_UNSAFE {
        ov_statement(walk, (*statement).body);
        return true;
    }
    if (*statement).kind == RS_DEFER || (*statement).kind == RS_FORGET {
        ov_expression(walk, (*statement).expr, null(*RmdTypeSyntax));
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

fn ov_resources_contract(stage: *OvStage, declaration: *RmdDecl,
                         user: *u8) -> *RmdName {
    var resources: *RsStage = user as *RsStage;
    var text: *u8 = "safe";
    var size: usize = 4usize;
    if (*declaration).kind == RMD_D_EXTERN ||
       rmd_map_get(&(*resources).unsafe_functions, declaration as usize) != null(*u8) {
        text = "unsafe";
        size = 6usize;
    }
    return ov_intern(stage, text, size);
}

fn ov_resources_read_declaration(reader: *RmdReader, user: *u8) -> *RmdDecl {
    var resources: *RsStage = user as *RsStage;
    if rr_is_name(reader, "unsafe") {
        rr_next(reader);
        if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdDecl); }
        if (*reader).token.kind != RR_FN {
            rr_error(reader, (*reader).token.offset, "expected fn after unsafe declaration modifier");
            return null(*RmdDecl);
        }
        var declaration: *RmdDecl = ov_function(reader);
        if !(*reader).failed {
            rs_put(resources, &(*resources).unsafe_functions, declaration as usize, declaration as *u8);
            if (*resources).failed { (*reader).failed = true; }
        }
        return declaration;
    }
    if (*reader).token.kind == RR_FN || (*reader).token.kind == RR_EXTERN {
        return ov_function(reader);
    }
    return rs_read_declaration(reader, user);
}

// Require an initialized resource stage. Retain both stages and hooks through preparation.
// Use the provider's same ABI domain and complete record and resource declarations.
fn ov_resources_init(stage: *OvStage, resources: *RsStage,
                      abi: *u8, hooks: *OvHooks) -> unit {
    *hooks = make OvHooks {
        user: resources as *u8, type_key: ov_resources_type_key,
        binding_type: ov_resources_binding_type, expression: ov_resources_expression,
        statement: ov_resources_statement, contract: ov_resources_contract
    };
    ov_init(stage, (*resources).context, abi, hooks);
}

// Read one complete source range before overload preparation.
// Retain the source descriptor and bytes through both stage lifetimes.
fn ov_resources_read(stage: *OvStage, source: *RmdSource,
                      begin: usize, end: usize) -> bool {
    var resources: *RsStage = (*(*stage).hooks).user as *RsStage;
    if (*stage).failed || (*resources).failed { return false; }
    var hooks: RmdReaderHooks = make RmdReaderHooks {
        user: resources as *u8, declaration: ov_resources_read_declaration,
        statement: rs_read_statement, prefix: rs_read_prefix, type_syntax: rs_read_type
    };
    if rr_read((*stage).context, source, begin, end, &hooks) == null(*RmdUnit) {
        (*stage).failed = true;
        (*resources).failed = true;
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// Require collected overloads whose declarations still have their source names.
// Resolve each resource drop by its complete exclusive-borrow signature.
fn ov_resources_drop_names(stage: *OvStage) -> bool {
    var resources: *RsStage = (*(*stage).hooks).user as *RsStage;
    var resource: *RsResource = (*resources).resources;
    while resource != null(*RsResource) && !(*stage).failed {
        var location: *RmdLoc = &(*(*resource).declaration).loc;
        var signature: *RmdTypeSyntax = ov_type(stage, RMD_T_FUNCTION, location);
        var parameter: *RmdTypeSyntax = ov_type(stage, RS_MUT, location);
        var record_type: *RmdTypeSyntax = ov_type(stage, RMD_T_NAME, location);
        var result: *RmdTypeSyntax = ov_type(stage, RMD_T_UNIT, location);
        var parameters: **RmdTypeSyntax = ov_alloc(stage, sizeof(*RmdTypeSyntax), alignof(*RmdTypeSyntax)) as **RmdTypeSyntax;
        if (*stage).failed { return false; }
        (*record_type).name = (*(*resource).declaration).name;
        (*parameter).base = record_type;
        parameters[0usize] = parameter;
        (*signature).params = parameters;
        (*signature).param_count = 1usize;
        (*signature).base = result;
        var group: *OvGlobal = ov_global(stage, (*resource).drop_name);
        if group == null(*OvGlobal) || (*group).first == null(*OvFunction) {
            ov_error(stage, location, "resource drop does not name a function");
            return false;
        }
        var selected: *OvFunction = ov_select(stage, group, signature, false, location);
        if (*stage).failed { return false; }
        (*resource).drop_name = (*selected).internal_name;
        resource = (*resource).next;
    }
    return !(*stage).failed;
}

// Select overloads once, publish source ABI names, and preserve resource import contracts.
// Call rs_prepare next. This operation does not check moves, loans, or cleanup.
fn ov_resources_prepare(stage: *OvStage) -> bool {
    var resources: *RsStage = (*(*stage).hooks).user as *RsStage;
    if (*stage).failed || (*resources).failed { return false; }
    if !ov_collect(stage) || !ov_resources_drop_names(stage) ||
       !ov_resolve(stage) || !ov_mangle(stage) {
        (*resources).failed = true;
        return false;
    }
    var function: *OvFunction = (*stage).first_function;
    while function != null(*OvFunction) && !(*resources).failed {
        if (*function).source_import {
            rs_source_import(resources, (*function).declaration);
        }
        function = (*function).all_next;
    }
    if (*resources).failed { (*stage).failed = true; }
    return !(*stage).failed;
}
